assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.notice: AI suggestions are never applied, saved as adapter versions, tested or run automatically. Conversations are temporary on this page and are cleared on refresh or when switching accounts or adapters.
assistant.empty: Describe your request and optionally reference code. Do not put passwords, Tokens or keys directly in code; use credential bindings so sensitive values are not sent to the AI.
assistant.secretCheckUnavailable: The current credential bindings could not be checked.
assistant.staleTitle: The current code changed while AI was generating this suggestion.
assistant.staleDescription: This suggestion was generated from an earlier edit.
assistant.archivedApplyBlocked: This adapter was deleted. Suggestions can be viewed but cannot be applied.
assistant.applied: Applied to the current browser code; continue with an explicit save, test and run.
assistant.commandPlaceholder: Enter a question or change request…
assistant.regenerateAria: Regenerate this reply (reusing the original code and context from when it was sent)
assistant.taskIncomplete: No code changes are ready to review yet. See the reply for the reason.
assistant.taskUnclassified: A reply was received, but completion of the code changes is unconfirmed. Review the reply.
assistant.recoveryHint: Retry original request reuses the code, context and attachments captured when sent. To use a replacement file, remove the old attachment and send a new round.
assistant.retryAria: Retry this round (reusing the original code, context and attachments from when it was sent)
assistant.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text manually

knowledgeSearch.label: Knowledge search
knowledgeSearch.available: Read-only tools for the configured knowledge source are allowed this round
knowledgeSearch.unavailable: Knowledge search is not enabled or configured; no external source will be contacted
knowledgeSearch.disabledReason: Knowledge search is off by default and applies only to this round
knowledgeSearch.notConfigured: The knowledge source is not configured; an administrator can configure it in Settings

attachments.addAria: Attach files: images (PNG / JPEG / WebP), PDF, DOCX, XLS, XLSX and text / code files
attachments.addTooltip: Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, DOCX, XLS, XLSX and text / code files
attachments.hint: Images / PDF / DOCX / XLS / XLSX / text and code files: up to {{count}}, {{size}} each, {{total}} total
attachments.guidance: Upload up to {{count}} attachments, max {{size}} each. Do not upload sensitive information.
attachments.guidanceLead: Upload up to {{count}} attachments, max {{size}} each.
attachments.privacyNoticeLead: Attachment content is sent to the model service configured by the administrator.
attachments.privacyNoticeSensitive: Do not upload passwords, keys or other sensitive credentials.

error.unsupported: Unsupported file type: only images (PNG / JPEG / WebP), PDF, DOCX, XLS, XLSX and text / code files are supported, and the file extension must match the declared type
error.filenameInvalid: Invalid attachment filename: use a plain filename without path separators
error.tooLarge: The file exceeds the per-file size limit ({{size}}): compress or split it and upload again
error.totalTooLarge: The attachments exceed the total size limit ({{total}}): remove or compress attachments and try again
error.countExceeded: Too many attachments (limit {{count}}): remove some and try again
error.readFailed: The file could not be read: choose the file again
error.empty: The file is empty: choose a file with content
error.rejected: A rejected attachment cannot be sent: remove it and try again

prepared.partial: Some content could not be prepared. Consider the coverage limits below.
prepared.failed: Attachment preparation failed. Retry preparation or remove it and choose another file.
prepared.expired: This round’s attachment has expired. Upload again and send a new round; Retry never replaces the original file.
prepared.pageCoverage: {{count}} / {{total}} pages available (the directory does not mean the model read every page)
prepared.onDemand: The model reads pages or cell ranges on demand. Unread content retains its source references.
prepared.textFallback: Document image conversion is unavailable. Only limited text can be read from PDF and Office files; scans, charts and layout may be unavailable.
prepared.visionUnknown: The current model’s visual capability is unconfirmed. Text and cell data do not mean images or charts were read.
prepared.visionUnavailable: Image or direct PDF support is unconfirmed for this model. Extracted text and cell data do not replace viewing charts.
prepared.visionAvailable: Model {{model}} is configured to accept images. Check attachment status and the reply to confirm what it read.

warnings.structurePartial: Text or table structure is incomplete; check the original pages.
warnings.printedAreaOnly: Page visuals cover the print area only; other cells require sheet-range reading.
warnings.formulaCacheMissing: Some formulas have no original cached values. Rendered display values are not proof of the original calculation.
warnings.ocrUnavailable: Scanned text recognition is incomplete; some content may be unavailable.
warnings.pageRenderFailed: Some page images could not be generated.
warnings.partial: Some content or representations are unavailable. Check the reply’s sources and coverage notes.

prepared.directoryLimited: The directory shows up to 64 pages and 32 sheets; other sources remain available for on-demand reading.
prepared.converterUnavailable: Document conversion is unavailable. Retry later or choose another file.
prepared.timeout: Attachment preparation timed out. Split the file and upload again.
prepared.encrypted: The attachment is password-protected. Upload a readable copy.
prepared.invalid: The attachment could not be parsed. Check for damage or a format mismatch.
prepared.originalAvailable: The original file is retained; check preparation coverage and reply sources for actual reading.
prepared.visionDeclared: An administrator configured model {{model}} to support images. Verify the actual reading result in the reply.
prepared.partialReady: Partially prepared; check attachment coverage and limits.

assistant.invalidRuntimeConfig: Fix the runtime parameters before sending: they must be a valid JSON object.

progress.succeeded: Changes are ready. Review the differences.

diff.title: AI suggested changes: compare with current code
diff.staleTitle: The current code changed while AI was generating this suggestion.
diff.staleDescription: This suggestion was generated from an earlier version; applying it will overwrite the current code.
diff.applyBlockedApplied: This suggestion has already been applied to the current code
diff.applyBlockedArchived: The adapter was deleted; the suggestion can only be viewed, not applied
diff.applyBlockedPermission: The current sharing permission does not allow AI or applying a suggestion
diff.applyBlockedNotReady: The current code has not finished loading. Try again later
diff.applyBlockedBusy: Another operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish
diff.applyBlockedLocked: The adapter is running; the suggestion cannot be applied

errors.gatewayPayloadTooLarge: The attachment request exceeds the 32 MiB gateway limit; remove or compress files and try again
errors.gatewayTimeout: The model service timed out after 660 seconds; check the network or try again later
errors.knowledgeUnavailable: Knowledge search is unavailable for this round; ask an administrator to configure an available source

assistant.stoppedWaiting: Stopped waiting. Existing messages are preserved. The model service may continue until the original deadline; you can send again.

ux.sentScope: Review code, configuration and attachments submitted with this round
ux.scopeHint: Your current code, dependencies, ordinary configuration, recent conversation and selected excerpts will be sent. This preview follows your current edits.
ux.attachmentScopeHint: Attachments follow this round’s request. Available pages do not mean the model read every page. Use credential bindings for secrets; never put them directly in code.
ux.sendPrivacy: Content is sent to the AI service. Do not include passwords or keys.
ux.supportedFormats: Supported attachment formats and model limits
ux.startTitle: Where would you like to start?
ux.exampleHint: Examples only fill the draft. You decide when to send.
ux.applyHint: Review before applying, then save, test and run separately.
ux.sessionTitle: Conversation stays on this page only
ux.sessionHint: Refreshing, leaving the page, or switching account or adapter clears it. Collapsing the assistant keeps it.
ux.requestSubmitted: This question received a reply. The attachments submitted with this round are listed below.
ux.requestUnconfirmed: This question has no complete reply yet. Submission and reading are unconfirmed. You can retry this round after the request ends.
ux.sentNotUnderstood: Submitting material does not mean the model fully read or understood it. Check key data against the reply. Return to the composer to send additional material in a new question.

explain.title: Explain code
explain.prompt: Explain the current code processing steps and highlight anything I should check.

fields.title: Organize fields
fields.prompt: Use this round’s attachments to organize fields and explain missing values. If none are attached, tell me what material you need first.

error.title: Analyze an error
error.prompt: Analyze the error I provide against the current code and suggest a fix.

ux.frozenScopeHint: These are the contents used when this round was sent. Later edits do not change this record.
ux.composerPrivacy: Do not send passwords or keys.

model.boundary: The current adapter code and ordinary configuration are sent to the model service for suggestions. Passwords and keys stored through credential bindings are not submitted with the code. Sensitive values written directly in code are sent with it.

provider.label: Model provider
provider.legacyCustomNotice: This setting uses a hidden legacy compatibility option. Choose a built-in or saved custom service to migrate.

model.baseUrlHint: Enter the model service URL, with or without /v1.
model.credentialPlaceholder: No access credential / Select a saved credential
model.modelPlaceholder: Enter or select a model name
model.refreshHint: Refresh only updates the list; it does not change the current model.
model.refreshEmpty: No models were found. You can still enter a model name.
model.refreshSuccess: Found {{count}} models. The current model is unchanged.
model.manualModelHint: You can still enter a model name.
model.refreshFailedManualHint: {{error}}; you can still enter a model name.
model.reasoningEffortDefault: Do not override the model default
model.reasoningHint: The model service decides by default. Only enable or disable reasoning when the service supports it.
model.baseUrlModelRequired: Enter the model service URL and model name
model.openaiReasoningRequired: Choose a supported reasoning effort when OpenAI reasoning is enabled
model.refreshBaseUrlRequired: Enter the model service URL first
model.testSuccess: Connection test passed. A model reply was received.
model.testFailed: Connection test failed. Check the model service configuration and network.
model.customProvidersHint: Add multiple services, select saved credentials, and set capabilities to match what each service supports. Keys are never shown here.
model.customDeleteReferenced: The active AI setting still references this service; the server will reject deletion.
model.customRequired: Service name and model service URL are required
model.credentialMissing: The selected credential was deleted or is no longer available. Your draft is preserved; select another or clear it.
model.credentialsLoadFailed: Could not load credentials, so availability of the selected credential is unconfirmed. Your draft is preserved. Please retry.

ux.credentialPrivacy: Only credential names are shown; keys stay hidden. AI requests are sent to the service above.
ux.testDraftHint: Test the current draft without saving it.
ux.testBoundary: A connection test checks whether the model replies. Validate image, file and document reading capabilities for your actual use case.
